newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong Dev. Bank to open Shanghai branch.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Dev. Bank to open Shanghai branch.

text.p: The Guangdong Development Bank (GDB) has gained approval to open new branches in six cities around China including Shanghai and Beijing, the Business News said on Saturday.
GDB, one of the first stock-based commercial banks to be set up in China, will also open branches in Nanjing, Hangzhou, Kunming and Dalian, the newspaper said, but gave no details of timing.
The bank, which has its head office in Guangzhou, was set up in November 1988 and currently has 26 branches, including one in Macao.
